content.text: {"id": "mm7009e3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "The ratio of COVID-19 patients aged ≥70 years requiring mechanical ventilation to those aged <50 years declined 67%"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the mean ratio of ventilated patients aged ≥70 years to those aged <50 years was 5.8:1 (99% confidence interval = 5.5–6.1"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Daily numbers of COVID-19 patients receiving mechanical ventilation"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Two-dose COVID-19 vaccination coverage among persons aged ≥70 years, 60–69 years, 50–59 years, and <50 years was 84.3%"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "2-dose vaccination coverage was 84% among persons aged ≥70 years and 10% among those aged <50 years"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "from 5.8:1 during October–December 2020 to 1.9:1 in February 2021"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "ecologic", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "an ecological study was conducted"}]}, {"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "To assess the impact of COVID-19 vaccination on the occurrence of severe COVID-19 at the population level"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "from 5.8:1 during October–December 2020 to 1.9:1 in February 2021"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the mean ratio of ventilated patients aged ≥70 years to those aged <50 years was 5.8:1 (99% confidence interval = 5.5–6.1"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "by analyzing the percentage of cases by age group (accounting for vaccination rates)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Vaccinated persons with missing age data were excluded from the analysis."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design", "outcome_types"]}
